explanation: Second normal form removes nonkey attributes that depend on only part of a composite key. Here the key is (StudentID, CourseID). StudentName depends only on StudentID, not on the full key, so it is a partial dependency and a 2NF violation. Grade depends on the full enrollment, while StudentID and CourseID are key attributes rather than nonkey attributes.
prompt: A table named Enrollment has this structure: Enrollment(StudentID, CourseID, StudentName, Grade), with primary key (StudentID, CourseID). Assume each StudentID identifies exactly one student name, and Grade depends on the student's enrollment in a specific course. Which attribute is a second-normal-form violation because it depends on only part of the composite key?

source.title: Normalization and other Data Modeling Methods
